**Spotify and internet radio in the Fallout 76 Pip-Boy RADIO tab.**

{{CHANGELOG}}

---

**Requirements:** Fallout 76 on Windows, [xScal](https://github.com/DCHoaxer/xScal), [HUDModLoader](https://github.com/GitCrazy-wc/hudmodloader) for the HUD card and transport relay, and the Spotify desktop client for Spotify Radio.

**Install:** install with Vortex and set Mod Type to Engine Injector, or extract the zip into the Fallout 76 folder. Add `76Radio.ba2` to `sResourceArchive2List` in `Fallout76Custom.ini`, and `76RadioHud` to `hudmodloader.ini`. The zip includes `INSTALL.txt` with the full steps.

**Download:** [Nexus Mods](https://www.nexusmods.com/fallout76/mods/4456)

76Radio is an unofficial mod. It is not endorsed by Bethesda, Microsoft or Spotify.
